Waarom dit relevant is voor jou als onde: Why this is relevant to you as an entrepreneur
MKB-bedrijven combineren steeds vaker fy: SMEs increasingly combine in-person sales, webshops and mobile payment apps. If payments and your accounting aren't smoothly connected, unnecessary manual tasks, delays in reconciliation and a higher risk of errors arise. That costs time, delays cash-flow visibility and makes financial decisions harder.
Vergelijking tussen de huidige situatie: Comparison between the current situation and the situation with preparing your twinfield accounting for mobile
Het betalingskanaal (mobiele betaalapp): The payment channel (mobile payment app) delivers transactions in a different format than your accounting package expects.
Er ontbreekt een automatische, betrouwba: There is no automatic, reliable connection or consistent data mapping between payment data and general ledger accounts.
Boekhouders of ondernemers voeren handma: Accountants or business owners perform manual imports, adjustments and reconciliations, which takes time and introduces errors.
Beslissing: voorbereiden op een directe: Decision: prepare for a direct API integration or choose a robust intermediary layer (middleware/CSV automation) until an open API is available.
Eigenaar: ondernemer of financieel veran: Owner: the business owner or financial responsible party (owner/CFO) makes the decision; execution lies with the accountant or a designated technical contact (IT/external integration agency).
Meetpunt: duidelijke checklist en accept: Metric: clear checklist and acceptance criteria: available mapping document + test set of 50 sample transactions that flow through the chain without errors (or another realistic test set that you agree on together).
Stap 1 — Signaal: inventariseer je huidi: Step 1 — Signal: inventory your current payment flows (owner: business owner/accountant)
Maak een overzicht van alle betaalmethod: Create an overview of all payment methods and apps you use.
Noteer welke velden per transactie besch: Note which fields are available per transaction (transaction date, reference, payment method, fees, refund status, customer ID).
Meetpunt: complete lijst met kanalen en: Metric: complete list of channels and, for each channel, the available fields (for example as a spreadsheet).
Stap 2 — Context: leg huidige import- en: Step 2 — Context: document current import and reconciliation rules (owner: accountant)
Beschrijf hoe transacties nu in Twinfiel: Describe how transactions currently enter Twinfield (or your current accounting system): bank statement, manual entry, CSV import, or via an intermediary.
Identificeer waar gegevens ontbreken of: Identify where data is missing or does not match your accounts or sales orders.
Meetpunt: document met alle uitzondering: Metric: document with all exception rules and an estimate of manual corrections per week (number of tickets or hours).
Stap 3 — Gevolg en beslissing: kies inte: Step 3 — Consequence and decision: choose integration strategy (owner: business owner/CFO)
Optie A: directe API-koppeling zodra bes: Option A: direct API connection as soon as available (less manual work, faster real-time insight).
Optie B: tijdelijke tussenlaag (middlewa: Option B: temporary intermediary layer (middleware, automatic CSV uploads, bank connections) that resolves most pain points while an open API is absent.
Besliskriterium: tijd tot resultaat, kos: Decision criteria: time to results, costs and security requirements. Record who decides and within what timeframe (e.g. 4 weeks).
Stap 4 — Actie: bouw een minimaal werken: Step 4 — Action: build a minimum viable prototype (owner: IT or external integration partner; guided by accountant)
Maak een mappingdocument: welk brveld wo: Create a mapping document: which brveld becomes which general ledger account or customer number in Twinfield.
Als er nog geen officiële API is: automa: If there is no official API yet: automate export/import via secure CSV exports, bank connection or a proven middleware (API-to-CSV, webhooks to storage that your accounting system can read).
Test met een kleine set echte transactie: Test with a small set of real transactions and record errors.
Meetpunten: aantal mismatches per 100 tr: Metrics: number of mismatches per 100 transactions; reconciliation lead time per batch.
Stap 5 — Resultaat: operationaliseer en: Step 5 — Outcome: operationalize and monitor (owner: accountant / financial responsible)
Zet monitoring op: wekelijkse checks op: Set up monitoring: weekly checks for exceptions and a monthly report that records manual corrections and time investment.
Stel een acceptatiegrens: bijvoorbeeld m: Set an acceptance threshold: for example a maximum of X exceptions per month (choose a realistic threshold based on your baseline).
Meetpunt: reductie in handmatige correct: Metric: reduction in manual correction time and percentage of automatic matches.
Stap 6 — Leren en aanpassen (owner: onde: Step 6 — Learn and adapt (owner: business owner/CFO)
Evalueer na 30–60 dagen: wat werkte, wel: Evaluate after 30–60 days: what worked, which fields need different mapping, and is automation reliable enough to scale up?
Documenteer beslissingen en wijzigingsve: Document decisions and change requests so the next iteration goes faster.
Meetpunt: aantal iteraties nodig voordat: Metric: number of iterations needed before the process is stable; satisfaction of the accountant (qualitative score).
Stel: een detailhandelaar verkoopt zowel: Example: a retailer sells both via a physical POS app and via a webshop. The POS app provides a payment reference that does not match the order reference in Twinfield. In step 4 you create a mapping rule for this channel: payment reference → order number via an additional matching step on amount + date. You test the rule with five recent transactions and document the result and error cases. This hypothetical example helps validate one specific matching rule without figures or claims about revenue.
De genoemde verwachting dat Twinfield ee: The stated expectation that Twinfield will release an open API is a forecast, not a guaranteed fact. Plan for two scenarios: one in which an API becomes available and one in which you continue with middleware/CSV.
Beperkingen: externe leveranciers of bet: Limitations: external vendors or payment apps can change data formats; ensure your mapping and tests are maintainable.
Eerlijk alternatief: niets doen betekent: Honest alternative: doing nothing means continuing with the current manual routines, but optimize those routines (standard templates, checklists) to reduce errors and wasted time.
Zorg dat degene die de integratie uitvoe: Ensure the person performing the integration is responsible for data security and access (owner: IT or external partner; overseer: business owner/CFO).
Meetpunt: vervallen toegangsrechten binn: Measurement point: access rights revoked within 24 hours during personnel changes; periodic review of who has access to payment data.
De kernles: bereid je voor op een mogeli: The core lesson: prepare for a possible direct API integration, but first address the biggest frictions with a small, controlled automation (mapping + prototype). That immediately reduces manual work and gives you the measurement points to later roll out an API integration safely and quickly.
Beperkingen van het bewijs: het signalem: Limitations of the evidence: the indication that Twinfield might release an open API is exploratory. Design your steps so you make progress regardless of whether that API arrives exactly as expected.
Plan nu één uur met je boekhouder of IT-: Schedule one hour now with your accountant or IT partner to inventory the payment channels and create a mapping document. Use that session to 1) note all payment apps, 2) record the required fields per channel, and 3) define two test transactions to validate an initial prototype.
